Approve the two core stages (Stage 1: O1 in Track A, then Stage 2: O6 in Track B), and approve or decline three suggested items: for each one you approve, give its rank in its track.
- **Full validation suite**, suggested for Tracks A and B. It would add posterior predictive checks on revision dispersion, PSIS-LOO against a constant-variance baseline, and pseudo-real-time checks, because your brief requires them before any finding is trusted.
- **Vintage provenance manifest**, Track A. Every vintage in the panel would trace to the archived release it came from, with a retrieval date. This is needed because BLS does not archive every vintage.
- **Covariate source traceability**, Track B. Every hand-built budget, staffing and sample value would trace to the document and page it came from, because the B covariates are all transcribed by hand.
